ThingDef.label: fireball cast scroll
ThingDef.description: A single-use casting scroll. Use it from a pawn's inventory to launch a fixed fireball: 18 flame damage in a 1.9-cell radius, up to 24 cells away. Takes 1 second to cast and has a 2-second cooldown shared by the stack. Consumes one scroll on a successful cast. Anyone can use it; no mana or learned spell is needed. Does not teach Fireball or scale with magical skill.

ThingDef.label: healing cast scroll
ThingDef.description: A single-use casting scroll. Use it from a pawn's inventory to heal up to three naturally healing wounds on different body parts, restoring 8 health to each wound. Range: 12 cells. Takes 0.3 seconds to cast and has a 2-second cooldown shared by the stack. Cannot heal hostile targets, undead or mechanoids. Consumes one scroll on a successful cast. Anyone can use it; no mana or learned spell is needed. Does not teach Heal or scale with magical skill.

ThingDef.label: blink cast scroll
ThingDef.description: A single-use casting scroll. Use it from a pawn's inventory to teleport the user to an unoccupied walkable cell up to 20 cells away, without requiring line of sight. Takes 1 second to cast and has a 2-second cooldown shared by the stack. Consumes one scroll on a successful cast. Anyone can use it; no mana or learned spell is needed. Does not teach Blink or scale with magical skill.

ThingDef.label: charged fireball staff
ThingDef.description: A staff holding 10 fixed Fireball casts. Equip it to launch a fireball dealing 18 flame damage in a 1.9-cell radius, up to 24 cells away. Takes 1 second to cast; cooldown: 2 seconds. Anyone can use it; no mana or learned spell is needed. Its magic does not scale with magical skill. Cannot be recharged and is destroyed after its final use. Also serves as a simple blunt melee weapon.

ThingDef.label: charged healing staff
ThingDef.description: A staff holding 10 fixed Heal casts. Equip it to heal up to three naturally healing wounds on different body parts, restoring 8 health to each wound. Range: 12 cells. Takes 0.3 seconds to cast; cooldown: 2 seconds. Cannot heal hostile targets, undead or mechanoids. Anyone can use it; no mana or learned spell is needed. Its magic does not scale with magical skill. Cannot be recharged and is destroyed after its final use. Also serves as a simple blunt melee weapon.

ThingDef.description: A staff holding 10 fixed Blink casts. Equip it to teleport the user to an unoccupied walkable cell up to 20 cells away, without requiring line of sight. Takes 1 second to cast; cooldown: 2 seconds. Anyone can use it; no mana or learned spell is needed. Its magic does not scale with magical skill. Cannot be recharged and is destroyed after its final use. Also serves as a simple blunt melee weapon.
